author: RIM team
description: Runs a quick poll in the open conversation from its panel. The poll and every vote are messages, so everyone with the plugin counts the same votes. In encrypted DMs and groups it works only if you also allow it to read and post in encrypted conversations.

commands.title: Poll: Start
commands.description: Posts a poll in this conversation. One open poll per conversation. Run it from the Poll panel.

arguments.name: options
arguments.description: 2 to 8 options separated by | or ;, each up to 80 characters.

commands.title: Poll: Vote
commands.description: Posts your vote in this conversation's poll. Your latest vote counts. Run it from the Poll panel.

arguments.name: choice
arguments.description: The option's number, or its text.

commands.title: Poll: Results
commands.description: Counts the votes of this conversation's poll and shows them in the panel.

commands.title: Poll: Close
commands.description: Posts the final tally of your poll in this conversation and closes it.

commands.title: Poll: Clear
commands.description: Forgets this conversation's poll on this device, without posting anything.

panels.title: Poll
panels.description: The open conversation's poll: start one, vote and see the votes.
